data.title: 伊什塔尔 · 星空下的真心话·「金星……是我最喜欢的一颗」
data.description: 【神殿屋顶·日落后】伊什塔尔与你并肩躺在平整的屋顶平台上，指向西方低空明亮的金星。天边的余晖尚未散尽，几颗较亮的星已显现。她难得放轻了声音，说起爱与战争之外那些不擅表达的心事。
data.action: 并肩躺看星空指金星，红瞳柔软低语
data.lighting: 西方地平线残留的暮光与神殿暖灯
data.camera: wide two-shot, two clothed figures reclining and Venus low in western twilight
data.promptProse: Ishtar reclines beside her clothed travelling companion on the temple's broad flat rooftop, raising one hand toward Venus low in the western sky. Her other arm rests beside her black goddess outfit and golden tiara. The horizontal wide two-shot includes separate reclining figures and the low horizon beyond the roof edge. Fading twilight softly outlines their profiles, while warm temple lamps illuminate the nearer stone and the pointing fingers.
